explication: FUTO Keyboard is an Android input method focused on offline, privacy-conscious typing. A user selects it for an editor; LatinIME coordinates the keyboard UI and input logic, which routes key and gesture events through language-specific IME engines and commits text to the editor. In parallel, dictionary-backed prediction supplies suggestions to the UI. The tree documents broader capabilities including configurable layouts, voice input, spellchecking, settings/actions, and model management. Several of these branches are represented by their exact enclosing source paths because their implementation was not sampled.
